The log moment has a strictly positive decreasing second derivative with O((s+1)^-2) bound, proving weight monotonicity, sharp inverse norm and summable exterior defect. Gamma ratios prove both interior and exterior k-scale profiles; uniform O(k^2/n^2) tails allow Riemann-sum convergence for every Lipschitz test function and every positive level count. Explicit level-set arithmetic yields u/sqrt(1-u), and Tonelli yields p B(p+1,1/2). The unweighted k-exact trace is an exact rational decomposition. The final-package checker passed 36,002 finite assertions, which supplement rather than replace infinite proofs.
